turn_prompts: Generate robust local tests for the approved task. Read the task_proposal required_behavior, public_contract, rejection_contract, constraints, and test_plan and map every requirement to at least one executable test; do not omit a listed method, header/token case, fallback path, parser error, public API contract, or rejection side effect. For middleware, assert both the returned response and whether the inner service was called, including TRACE and same-origin/none exemptions, malformed or non-UTF-8 input, authority/Host fallback, exact byte comparisons, and every rejection error/extension contract when those behaviors are specified. Keep tests deterministic and local, use the repository's existing test helpers and Rust compatibility policy, and do not rely on hidden services or unspecified timing. Before submitting, audit the generated test files against the proposal line by line and repair any coverage gap. Produce only the required structured artifact, then invoke the stage-private harbor_submit_stage_output dynamic tool with it. Do not finish with prose alone; only an accepted tool submission is a stage result.
